subject.title: fix(browser): prove post-action target continuity before adopting a tab

question: Should extension-relay expose relay-owned opaque target handles as the supported CDP identity contract, replacing externally visible raw Chrome renderer target IDs?
rationale: This is an externally observable compatibility boundary, and the implementation cannot determine whether existing clients require a transition period or whether the new identity model is the intended permanent contract.

options.title: Adopt opaque relay handles
options.body: Approve opaque per-binding handles as the relay contract, with live paired-extension proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve raw IDs temporarily
options.body: Keep the present raw-ID contract or add a documented transition while a compatible relay identity migration is designed.

recommendation.title: Adopt opaque relay handles
recommendation.body: Approve opaque per-binding handles as the relay contract, with live paired-extension proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical report defines the relay identity-lifetime requirements and the PR explicitly requests this contract confirmation.
